dataset_scope: Beginner-friendly MVP dataset for product-to-standard mapping and BIS service routing. It is not legal advice and should not be used as the final authority for compliance decisions.

standards_fields.standard_number: Indian Standard number or standard family exactly as listed by BIS where available.
standards_fields.title: Official title or lightly normalized title from BIS source.
standards_fields.product_category: Product/category phrase useful for search and embeddings.
standards_fields.applicability: Plain-English scope based on the BIS listing.
standards_fields.certification_scheme: BIS scheme or hallmarking context only when supported by official source.
standards_fields.verification_status: Evidence label showing whether the row is source-verified.

chunk_fields.standard_number: Indian Standard number where applicable; blank for service/process chunks.
chunk_fields.title: Standard, source page, PDF, or service title.
chunk_fields.category: Product category, BIS service type, or document category.
chunk_fields.section: Highest available hierarchy level: source page, scheme, or PDF text section.
chunk_fields.subsection: More specific segment or row type.
chunk_fields.clause: Clause when available. For seed rows this stores the record/service id, not a legal standard clause.
chunk_fields.page_start: PDF page number when available; null for HTML/source-list rows.
chunk_fields.page_end: PDF page number when available; null for HTML/source-list rows.
chunk_fields.source_url: Official source URL or linked official document URL.
chunk_fields.document_version: Captured/verified status. Date-sensitive sources should be rechecked.

safety_rules: Never claim certification from IS number detection alone.
For compliance-critical answers, cite official BIS/QCO source and recommend verification.
Rows with full standard document unavailable should not be used to answer clause-level questions.
